title: Refuse a different source repository unless override is explicit
preconditions: Source checkout origin is acme/actual.git, while declared Saga source identity is acme/other.git; source has two commits with a changed file.

steps.action: Read source-backed comparison without a mismatch override.
steps.expected_result: Comparison refuses the checkout and does not leak credentials from origin.
Comparison returns the actual checkout changes.

expected_result: Comparison returns the actual checkout changes.
